title: Lebesgue's inequality ∫_a^b F′ ≤ F(b) − F(a) for monotone F (lower-integral form)
statement: Let F : ℝ → ℝ be monotone (nondecreasing) and a, b ∈ ℝ, and let F′ := deriv F (Mathlib's derivative, equal to 0 at points where F is not differentiable). Then the lower Lebesgue integral over (a, b) with respect to Lebesgue measure satisfies ∫⁻_{(a,b)} ofReal(F′(t)) dt ≤ ofReal(F(b) − F(a)), where ofReal : ℝ → [0, ∞] is ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), Monotone F → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, ENNReal.ofReal (deriv F t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (F b - F a)
